caption:
👁️ ROP screening | PG Notes · Neonatology 09

👶 Screen (India): birth weight < 2000 g or GA < 34 weeks; 34–36 weeks with risk factors (O₂, sepsis, shock)
📅 First exam by day 30 of life; by day 20 if < 28 weeks or < 1200 g

📊 Stages (ICROP): 1 demarcation line · 2 ridge · 3 extraretinal fibrovascular proliferation · 4 partial detachment · 5 total detachment
➕ Plus disease: dilated, tortuous posterior vessels
🗺️ Zones: I around the disc · II to the nasal ora · III temporal crescent

💉 Treat Type 1 ROP (ETROP): zone I any stage with plus, or stage 3 without plus · zone II stage 2 or 3 with plus → laser or anti-VEGF within 48–72 h

⭐ Pearls: avoid O₂ swings (target SpO₂ about 90–95% in preterms) · AP-ROP needs urgent treatment · after anti-VEGF follow up longer (late recurrence)

📚 Ref: Indian ROP guidelines (RBSK/NNF), ICROP3, ETROP
